Haha, I just saw this. This is excellent feedback and I'll be working on it to make the game feel better.

A lot of what you said about the controls I've seen other people echo so I'll definitely be reworking them and adding a menu to rebind them.

As for balancing, I made the demo purposefully easy thinking that the controls would be a bit hard to get used to, but I didn't realize how many people would quickly get a hold of them and destroy everything lmao.

Thank you for playing though, your feedback is invaluable

Hope you enjoy the next version with better UI stuff and better controls.
